mbs.text: Trennet, an ambitious vedalken wizard, watches a spire collapse to the Phyrexians and, wanting the power he was promised, volunteers to free Research Spire Eleven, where he meets his rival Sarja, who mocks him.
Guessing that Sarja plans to unleash a hellkite on the Phyrexians, he hides inside his own clone shell, planning to dominate her beast once it appears.
When the Phyrexians shred his shell, he hides behind Sarja's and dominates the drake-lord's mind to destroy the other Phyrexians, but his spell fails and the drake-lord crushes him.
Sarja kills the drake-lord and demands the Spire as the price of freeing him, and Trennet concedes and is healed by Lumengrid shapers.
